## What is the resource?

Blog from Microsoft sharing insights and practical frameworks for considering generative AI as a research instrument. Available as downloadable pdf.

## Why does this matter to the project?

The guide’s purpose is to support researchers in asking well‑formed questions about the tools they use and in reflecting on the role that those tools play in research processes.
